meta.title: Web Devs Bulgaria — AI solutions, websites and applications for business
meta.description: WordPress and hand-coded websites, online stores, custom applications, AI assistants and integrations between your systems. Indicative prices and a fixed quote before we start.

hero.lead: We make artificial intelligence useful for small and medium businesses: assistants, automation and links between your systems. And we build what it stands on — websites, online stores and custom applications. With a clear price from the first conversation.

websites.title: Websites and online stores
websites.lead: Your website is the first place customers check. We make it fast, clear and easy to find — and we stay to maintain it.
websites.short: Hand-coded websites, WordPress websites with a custom theme, online stores, maintenance and SEO.

applications.title: Custom software
applications.lead: When off-the-shelf tools are not enough, we build a system for your own processes — a customer portal, an internal system or a mobile app.
applications.short: Portals, mobile apps, small ERP systems and links between the software you already use.

ai.title: Artificial intelligence that gets work done
ai.lead: We do not sell artificial intelligence for its own sake. We put it where it saves hours: answering customers, processing documents, repetitive tasks.
ai.short: An assistant that answers your customers from your own materials. Automation of manual work. AI on your own server when the data must not leave the company.

audience.lead: You do not need to know exactly what you need. See which situation is closest to yours.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: What people ask us most often before the first conversation.

items.question: How long does a website take?
items.answer: A WordPress website of up to 5 pages is ready in 7–10 working days. A hand-coded company website usually takes 3 to 5 weeks, and an online store 4 to 8 weeks. The deadline is written into the proposal before we start.

items.question: Can I start with WordPress and move to a custom-built site later?
items.answer: Yes, and many clients start exactly that way. The content, the domain and your Google rankings carry over. Only what sits underneath changes.

items.question: Who owns the website, the code and the domain?
items.answer: You do. The domain is registered in your name, and the code and access details are handed over with documentation. If you decide to continue with another team, you take everything with you.

items.question: What do I pay every month?
items.answer: Only the domain and hosting are required. Maintenance from €40 per month is optional. The AI assistant has a monthly fee from €39 that covers the cost of the AI model and looking after it.

items.question: Do I need artificial intelligence?
items.answer: Not always. If it will save you time or bring you enquiries, we will suggest it. If not, we will tell you plainly that it is not worth the money.

items.question: What if I do not know exactly what I need?
items.answer: That is normal. Tell us what you want to achieve and we will suggest an option and an indicative price within one working day, with no obligation on your side.
